description:
modules/identityaccess — GET /traeger/school-roles/ (#4810) at a Träger with two
schools: the Träger's schools, the binding of the Träger transaction, its
roles and their permission selections in one statement each; then per school
the binding of its tenant transaction and its roles with their holder counts
in one statement. Flat in the number of roles and holders; one tenant
transaction per school (ADR 0317).
